text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she's been getting
tons more
interview requests since the
spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's battle against a more
obvious
difficulty has led to increased
exposure, and that
might be helping her
fans feel more comfortable
giving her
their open support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It does feel a little late coming, but
perhaps her
ambitions are close to being
realized.

that
everything'll change after this race?

text_block_list.text:

recognize my
